review.verdict: The cast is correctly human-vs-robot and the idea is legible once you read the SOLD/LAUNCHED labels, but the vault reads as a target, there's no auction hammer, the regulator's arm visually points at the rocket instead of the falling chats, and the static rocket undercuts the launch beat — these push it just under passing.
revisionNotes: Redesign the vault component: the dial currently reads as a target/bullseye, not a vault door. Replace the crosshair lines with a wheel-lock or handle shape, and keep a taller, narrower building silhouette so it reads as a leaning vault, not a shield.
Add an auctioneer's hammer as a raw prop near the chats/SOLD sign; right now the auction idea rests entirely on the text label, with no hammer shape anywhere in the scene.

Re-aim the regulator's pointing arm (reg, x=0.602) toward the vault/chat bubbles instead of toward the rocket; as drawn the arm visually links the person to the launch pad, muddying which half of the split joke they belong to.

Scale up 'chats' (currently 0.55) and add a connecting trail from the vault so the bubbles read as spilling rather than two floating shapes; make the child icon a recognizable small head/body, not a plain dot.
Give the rocket a flame or motion trail, or tilt it off the pad, so LAUNCHED is shown by the art, not only by the label — right now it reads as a static toy on a stand.
Make the green dome under the orbit ring read as Earth (full curved arc or surface texture) rather than a flat hill.

review.verdict: The split-frame idea and casting (human regulator, AI-only robot) are sound, but key story props — the spilling chats, the child icon, the gavel, and the satellite ring — are rendered so sparsely or awkwardly (robot perched atop the Earth like a hat, hammer reduced to scribbles) that the specific joke doesn't fully land; not yet ready to publish.
revisionNotes: Rebuild the 'chats' stream as 4-5 small glowing speech bubbles trailing from vault to regulator's hand, plus a distinct small child-icon bubble among them per brief — now it's one bubble and two dots, so 'millions of chats, children's included' barely reads.
The 'hammer' element reads as disconnected scribbles, not a gavel. Rebuild as one clear handle+head shape, scale ~1.2, anchored closer to the SOLD sign so the auction beat is legible.

Move 'sat-bot' off the top rim of the Earth silhouette (currently looks like it's standing on the planet like a hat) — anchor along the 'orbit' ellipse path instead, around y=0.14-0.16, so it reads as waving from an orbiting satellite.
Thicken the 'orbit' ring stroke and enlarge/space the satellite rects along it; at current scale 0.7 with a thin stroke the 'ring of datacenters' nearly disappears.
Clarify the 'vault' silhouette — the dial+triangle-roof shape reads ambiguously as a bomb or plunger. Add a small doorway or window so it unmistakably reads as a leaning building/vault.
Left ground area between vault and SOLD sign is empty; tighten the gap so the chain vault → chats → hammer → SOLD reads as one continuous beat left to right.
